summary.firstLine: Deterministic scan unavailable (impeccable detect not shipped in advisory mode); manual Playwright measurement used.
summary.productCardText: Order: 375/375 product cards render name AND price as HelveticaNeueArabic-Bold 16px #111111 (identical style).
summary.orderPlaceholders: Order: 67 of 375 product cards have no photo; each shows a 44x44 SVG pictogram stroked #5c5c58.
summary.sheetHero: Item sheet hero : 512x512 photo, background-size contain, element transform scale(1.3) -> 465.4x312 box clipped by an overflow:hidden 358x240 container.
summary.latinStrings: Order: 34 text blocks contain Latin-script product names (e.g. "TURKISH COFFEE", "Iced Americano Cold Foam"); Pay shows "E2E-USER" (seeded test id).
summary.imgAlt: All 327 elements measured carry alt="" (RN-web accessibility image).
summary.syntheticBold: Fonts are separate @font-face families per weight, all declared weight "normal". 10 text nodes (Home 9, Rewards 1) request font-weight 700 from HelveticaNeueArabic-Roman; canvas ink test: +45.8% ink at 600/700 vs 400, identical advance width (176.8px) => browser-synthesised bold. -Bold family shows no change across weights.
limitations: impeccable detect / detect.js not shipped (advisory mode) — not downloaded or run.

Live menu request https://almond-gules.vercel.app/api/menu/app was blocked (no network beyond localhost); the app rendered its bundled menu (local /almond/menu/*.webp). Order counts reflect that snapshot.
Web build only (react-native-web); native iOS/Android rendering, hitSlop and native shadows not measurable here.
Visual alignment is a heuristic (text ink box vs first wider ancestor content box).
Contrast uses ancestor background walk (first opaque bg, translucent layers composited, ancestor opacity applied); no text overlaps a photo (checked with clipped rects).
